summary: The market is steadying slightly near the lows: the Sensex has trimmed its loss to about 900 pts and the Nifty is near 22,300, but volatility has jumped sharply.

detail.laggards: Autos, Bajaj Auto, Apollo, Max Healthcare
detail.tone: After a 1,045-pt peak-to-trough fall, the Sensex has steadied a little from the 2 pm lows, but the VIX spike shows hedging demand into the three-day break.

top.title: Rate-hike fears for October MPC weigh
top.line: Analysts cite fears of an RBI rate hike at the Oct 5–7 meet as a key trigger
more: The rate decision is due on October 7
High crude prices and FII selling are also cited

top.title: IPO flood seen draining market liquidity
top.line: A heavy IPO pipeline is absorbing cash just as FIIs sell, leaving few buyers
more: Analysts flag lack of liquidity as a reason for the steep fall
Moneyview and A-One Steels listed today

top.title: India VIX jumps 16%
top.line: Volatility spikes as traders hedge ahead of the Gandhi Jayanti long weekend
more: Markets are shut on Friday, Oct 2
Gap risk on Monday is driving demand for protection

sources.title: Business Standard: why markets are falling
